sprints.name: Sprint 23 - Foundation
sprints.goal: Build foundation services and CI baseline

sprints.name: Sprint 24 - Core Pipeline
sprints.goal: Deliver asynchronous task triage, WIP load balancing, and standup reporting

sprints.name: Sprint 25 - Production Scale
sprints.goal: Scale to multi-project Jira instances and enterprise audit webhooks

issues.summary: Implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool server for Atlassian Jira
issues.description: Establish MCP JSON-RPC protocol endpoint exposing Jira search, issue get, and transition tools with strict schema validation.
issues.acceptance_criteria: MCP tools pass integration tests and respond within 200ms with valid JQL results.

issues.description: Constraint satisfaction rebalancer to calculate team capacity and propose safe assignee reassignments.
issues.acceptance_criteria: Detects overloaded engineers exceeding max_in_progress and proposes candidates with highest affinity.

issues.summary: Refactor tokenized Jira JQL query parser and optimizer
issues.description: Cache JQL query ASTs and minimize remote round-trips for repetitive sprint health checks.
issues.acceptance_criteria: Reduces Jira API calls by at least 40% across repeated standup executions.

issues.summary: Develop end-to-end integration test suite for load balancer
issues.description: Verify rebalancing algorithm under extreme load scenarios with 100+ tickets and heterogeneous skill sets.
issues.acceptance_criteria: All test fixtures pass with zero unintended ticket mutations.

issues.summary: Automate daily standup brief synthesis with Slack markdown
issues.description: Generate concise daily standups grouping tasks by completed, in-flight, blocked, and pending approvals.
issues.acceptance_criteria: Formatted output integrates directly with Slack webhook with zero formatting anomalies.

issues.summary: Implement sprint retrospective analytics and rollover detection
issues.description: Calculate planned vs completed velocity, identify bottleneck patterns, and formulate retro questions.
issues.acceptance_criteria: Generates structured retrospective report with actionable continuous improvement metrics.

issues.summary: Configure SOC-2 compliant cryptographic audit log format
issues.description: Log all mutations with UTC timestamp, authorizer email, issue key diff, and status in TSV and JSONL.
issues.acceptance_criteria: Audit logs record all mutative actions without dropping fields.

issues.summary: Implement automated sprint queue triage classifier
issues.description: Automatically classify incoming backlog tickets into Ready, Needs Info, Blocked, or Sprint Candidate.
issues.acceptance_criteria: Categorizes backlog with at least 95% accuracy against human test set.

issues.summary: Design predictive delivery risk detection radar
issues.description: Flag delivery risks such as stale issues (>3d), critical path bottlenecks, and developer overload.
issues.acceptance_criteria: Surfaces high-risk issues with impact analysis and recommended action.

issues.summary: Security vulnerability review on Jira webhook ingress
issues.description: Verify HMAC signature headers on incoming Jira webhooks to prevent spoofing or replay attacks.
issues.acceptance_criteria: Payload validation rejects unsigned or expired requests with 401 Unauthorized.

issues.summary: Fix stale task notification timeout in progress pulse
issues.description: Progress pulse times out when reading historical snapshots exceeding 10MB.
issues.acceptance_criteria: Streams file chunks rather than loading entire snapshot into memory.

issues.summary: Support custom field mapping in team-map.local.yaml
issues.description: Allow mapping arbitrary Jira customfield_XXXXX IDs to story points, sprint IDs, and sprint dates.
issues.acceptance_criteria: Custom fields resolve correctly during dry-run and apply executions.
